theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_blowUp_hypotheses
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k ℓ : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid (m + 1 + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (x : Euclid (m + 1 + k)) (θ : ℝ), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (m + 1 + ℓ) N → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → x ∈ T.support \ boundarySupport T → HasMassDensity T x θ → ∀ (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ j, IsOpen (dilation x (lams j) '' U)) ∧ (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, closedBall (0 : Euclid (m + 1 + k)) R ⊆ dilation x (lams j) '' U) ∧ (∀ j, IsMinimizingIn (blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne') (dilation x (lams j) '' (U ∩ N))) ∧ (∀ j, (blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne').support ⊆ dilation x (lams j) '' (U ∩ N)) ∧ (∀ R : ℝ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, c ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne').massOn (ball 0 R) ≤ c) ∧ (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (dilation x (lams j) '' U) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1 + k)) m) ⊆ ball 0 R → (blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne').boundary ω = 0) ∧ (∀ G : ℝ, 0 < G → ∃ πs : ℕ → Euclid (m + 1 + k) → Euclid (m + 1 + k), (∀ᶠ j in atTop, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (πs j) (ball 0 G) ∧ MapsTo (πs j) (ball 0 G) (dilation x (lams j) '' (U ∩ N)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ dilation x (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G, πs j y = y) ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖y‖) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ∀ z ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y - πs j z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖)
